definitions.explanation: An outstanding or highly acclaimed work of art, literature, film, or other creative endeavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名作|めいさく}だ。
⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名作|めいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a library that has collected masterpieces from around the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧{名作|めいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}した→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧。
examples.english: As an adult, I reread the classic works I had read as a child.

notes:
Applies broadly to literature, film, music, art, games, and other creative works. Often used in book/film series titles like ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{名作|めいさく}⟦{劇場|げきじょう}→劇場：02714_gekijou⟧ (World Masterpiece Theater) or {名作|めいさく}⟦{選|せん}→選：09879_sen⟧ (selection of classics).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不朽|ふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名作|めいさく} — timeless masterpiece
- ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧{名作|めいさく} — hidden gem
- {名作|めいさく}⟦{選|せん}→選：09879_sen⟧ — selection of classic works
- {名作|めいさく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ — to be called a masterpiece

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧ — masterpiece (also means 'great joke/story')
- ⟦{大作|たいさく}→大作：12196_taisaku⟧ — major work (emphasis on scale, not necessarily quality)
